# Paths that make up the grader. A PR that breaks one of these rules fails
# the `protected-paths` check unless it carries the `approved-protected`
# label, which only Khakha adds.
#
# The check always reads this file from the base branch, so a PR that edits
# it changes nothing until it merges (and editing it needs the label anyway).
#
# Format: one rule per line, `<kind> <glob>`. Blank lines and lines starting
# with `#` are ignored.
#
# Kinds:
#   any       adding, modifying, deleting or renaming a matching file needs
#             the label.
#   existing  modifying, deleting or renaming a matching file needs the
#             label. Adding a new file does not.
#
# Globs match the whole repo-relative path. `*` and `?` stay inside one path
# segment. `**` matches any number of segments, including none.

# Task briefs and their acceptance criteria.
any tasks/**

# The PRD, the plan and its Decisions table.
any docs/**

# CI, this check, its rules and the PR template.
any .github/**

# License allowlist and pinned toolchain.
any deny.toml
any rust-toolchain.toml

# Perf budget thresholds. T-005 creates this file.
any crates/helm-bench/budgets.toml

# The rules every agent follows.
any AGENTS.md

# Acceptance tests. Adding tests never weakens the grader; changing or
# removing existing ones can.
existing crates/*/tests/**
